title: Longhorn PHP 2026 - Call For Papers
content:
Longhorn PHP is back, with a slightly updated format - this year our conference in Austin, TX, will feature a tutorial day (Thursday, October 15), followed by a main conference day (Friday, October 16). We are currently accepting talk and tutorial submissions. While the CFP is open, we also have our Blind Bird tickets available for sale.

Register today!

Follow us on signup for emails at to get notified with important conference updates.Mastodonlonghornphp.com
author: PHP.net news & announcements
